name: Mining Consultant

angles.text: As a miner, you can speak with Kelsey Fargo, an apprentice stationed just outside Echo Ridge Mine. She is a local contact for learning about mineral work and conditions nearby.
As a human, you begin in Northshire Valley, a training ground for new adventurers. The abbey’s archives and nearby mines matter to the region, and kobolds threaten them both.

faq.answer: Kelsey Fargo is a mining apprentice stationed just outside Echo Ridge Mine in Northshire Valley. From her post, she can watch the local kobolds’ movements and habits.
Kelsey Fargo has seen kobolds running back and forth with books while arguing. She suspects they stole the volumes from the library inside Northshire Abbey, but their purpose is unknown.
Echo Ridge Mine lies in the hills northwest of Northshire Abbey, in northwestern Northshire Valley. Kobolds have heavily infested it and disrupted mining operations.

aliases: where do the books come from
faq.answer: The books are believed to have come from the library inside Northshire Abbey. Local human clergy and scholars keep records, scriptures, and historical volumes there.
faq.q: Where are the kobolds getting these books?

faq.answer: You are sent to speak with Kelsey Fargo outside the mine about the strange kobold activity. From her post, she can tell you what she has witnessed.
faq.q: What is the purpose of consulting the mining apprentice?

faq.answer: Kobolds around Echo Ridge Mine have been seen yelling at one another and carrying off written texts. Their behavior is unusually erratic compared with their usual digging and defense of their territory.
faq.q: What strange behavior have the kobolds exhibited?

sections.body: Kobold trouble at Echo Ridge Mine has taken an odd turn. The creatures defend their underground claims and gather candles, but now their coordinated disturbances have caught the authorities’ attention. You are sent to Kelsey Fargo, a mining apprentice stationed near the entrance. From her post outside the tunnels, she has watched the kobolds closely.
sections.title: Trouble at the Mine

sections.body: Kelsey Fargo has seen kobolds scampering back and forth with heavy books and arguing as they go. She believes they stole the volumes from the library inside Northshire Abbey. What the tunnel dwellers want with books they cannot read remains unclear.
sections.title: Scholarly Scavengers

summary: At Echo Ridge Mine, Kelsey Fargo watches the kobolds from her post outside the entrance. Their strange movements have drawn local attention.
